text: Testing plays a crucial role in software development. Unit tests check individual pieces of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly in isolation. Integration tests then verify that these pieces work together smoothly when combined. A popular approach is test-driven development, where you write a test before writing the actual code, which helps you focus on the desired outcome. The main benefit of testing is confidence. With regular, automated tests, developers can change or improve code without constantly worrying about breaking something. This confidence makes the entire process faster and reduces stressful surprises in the final product.
